description_en: Retrieves the details of a dedicated join permission authorization order
description_zh: 调用GetJoinPermissionAuthOrder获取专用凭证授权工单的详细信息
name: GetJoinPermissionAuthOrder

Data.description_en: The details of the authorization order

AcceptedMillis.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the order was accepted, in milliseconds
AcceptedMillis.description_zh: 工单被接受的 UNIX 时间戳，以毫秒为单位

ApplyingMillis.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the order was initiated, in milliseconds
ApplyingMillis.description_zh: 发起工单的 UNIX 时间戳，以毫秒为单位

CanceledMillis.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the order was canceled, in milliseconds
CanceledMillis.description_zh: 工单被取消的 UNIX 时间戳，以毫秒为单位

JoinPermissionId.description_en: The ID of the dedicated join permission to be authorized
JoinPermissionId.description_zh: 要授权的专用入网凭证ID

OrderState.description_en:
The order status. Valid values:

APPLYING: The order has been initiated and is waiting for the target tenant to process.
ACCEPTED: The order has been accepted.
REJECTED: The order has been rejected.
CANCELED: The order has been canceled
OrderState.description_zh:
工单状态。取值：

APPLYING：工单发起，等待目标租户处理。
ACCEPTED：工单被接受。
REJECTED：工单被回绝。
CANCELED：工单被取消

OwnerAliyunId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the dedicated join permission owner who initiated the authorization
OwnerAliyunId.description_zh: 发起授权的专用入网凭证拥有者的阿里云账号ID

RejectedMillis.description_en: The UNIX timestamp when the order was rejected, in milliseconds
RejectedMillis.description_zh: 工单被回绝的 UNIX 时间戳，以毫秒为单位

RenterAliyunId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the target tenant for the dedicated join permission
RenterAliyunId.description_zh: 专用入网凭证的目标租户的阿里云账号ID

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful
